nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender at deployment and updated during ownership transfer.

Total token supply, minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.

Caller-controlled address used for owner assignment, allowance keying and balance debiting.
SafeMath addition helper performing c = a + b with a require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath subtraction helper performing c = a - b with a require(b <= a) underflow guard.
SafeMath multiplication helper performing c = a * b with a division-based overflow guard.
SafeMath division helper performing c = a / b with a require(b > 0) guard.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment.
onlyOwner function that nominates a new owner address into newOwner.
Two-step ownership acceptance requiring msg.sender == newOwner before rotating owner.

Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub and safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens, allowing unlimited re-approval with no double-spend check.
Spends an allowance to move tokens from a source account; debits balances and allowed without an explicit allowance check.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender, then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract in the same transaction.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts any plain ETH transfer.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract to rescue tokens.
Raw addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded only by require(c >= a).
Raw subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded only by require(b <= a).
Raw multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded by a division comparison.
